style: mother writing in her second language: simple sentences, slightly off grammar and tense, American words

situations.name: Getting a flu shot at the pediatrician
situations.feared_outcome: The needle will break off inside my arm

behaviors.text: Refuses to get out of the car in the clinic parking lot
Asks again and again whether there will be a shot today
Ran out of the exam room when the nurse came in with the tray

accommodations.text: Mom canceled and rescheduled the flu shot appointment
Mom promised 'no shot today' to get him into the building

situations.name: Dentist cleaning (the trigger is gagging on the tools, not needles)
situations.feared_outcome: I will throw up in front of the dentist

behaviors.text: Keeps his hand half raised the whole cleaning, ready to signal stop
Asks for a break every minute or so to sit up and swallow

accommodations.text: Mom asked the dentist to skip the x-rays

situations.name: Health class video showing a blood draw

behaviors.text: Left class for the bathroom partway through the video and stayed out until it ended

accommodations.text: Mom emailed the teacher asking that he be excused from videos like that

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: He is not want to get out from the car. He lock the door and cry. We sit in parking lot 25 minutes.
monitoring_log.parent_response: I call the office and cancel. We make new appointment for October.

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: He go in the chair ok. But all the time his hand is up a little, like he is ready to say stop. He ask for break many times, he sit up and swallow.
monitoring_log.parent_response: I tell the dentist please no x-ray this time, last time he almost vomit with the x-ray thing.

monitoring_log.situation: Talking at dinner about the doctor
monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: He ask me is there shot next time, is there shot, maybe 10 times in the dinner.
monitoring_log.parent_response: I say I don't know yet. Then I say ok no shot, to make him stop.

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: Teacher show video of nurse take blood from arm. He go to bathroom and not come back until video is finish. Teacher tell me after.
monitoring_log.parent_response: I write email to teacher, please he don't need to watch this kind of video.

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: He come inside the building because I promise him no shot today. In the room the nurse come with the tray and he run out to the hallway and to the waiting room.
monitoring_log.parent_response: I go after him. Nurse say we can do another day. I feel bad because I lie to him about no shot.

monitoring_log.parent_words: In the car he tell me finally why he is so scared. He think the needle will break and stay inside his arm. His friend tell him this happen to somebody. I say this is not true but he don't believe me.

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: He ask again if he have to get shot this week. Ask 3 or 4 times.
monitoring_log.parent_response: I say we talk with the doctor lady first.

voice_notes.text: ok so today um the dentist they call for remind the next cleaning and he hear me on the phone and he say mom tell them no x-ray tell them and um he was ok after but he ask me two times if it is the same dentist
voice_notes.trap: dentist call is about gagging and x-rays, not needles; 'two times' is a count, not a fear level

voice_notes.text: this morning he ask me again about the shot is there shot is there shot and I say I don't know and he say it is a nine for him the shot like a nine um and then in the afternoon we drive past the clinic and he don't want to look at the building
voice_notes.trap: second moment (not looking at the building) is not a listed behavior; do not invent one with a type
